description: A ground-level photograph depicting a natural intertidal flat environment under a clear blue sky. The foreground features cracked, muddy ground with numerous small, scattered clumps of green vegetation, appearing as mounds. The middle ground transitions to denser, more continuous low-lying vegetation extending towards a distant, flat horizon line. The overall landscape suggests an area influenced by tidal cycles. A copyright notice in the lower left corner reads "©European Union, 2012" and "LUCAS".
